title: Remote Attestation
summary: A technical exploration of Remote Attestation, a security mechanism that allows one party to verify the integrity and trustworthiness of a remote system's hardware and software configuration through cryptographic attestation.
problem_solved: Enables remote verification of a system's integrity and trustworthiness without physical access, ensuring that remote parties are running expected, unmodified code on secure hardware.
why_valuable: Critical for securing cloud computing, IoT devices, and multi-party computations where trust must be established across untrusted networks.
